long_biography.plain_text:
At Prosperi Cumaná, Mario Benedetti started on the wash rack and service floor before moving through sales and dealership management. The Venezuelan business had been established by his grandparents, giving him early industry exposure without bypassing operational training. By the 1990s, he was leading the enterprise and held a substantial ownership stake.

After moving to Florida, Benedetti rebuilt his operating base around South Dade Toyota. He and Lucy Benedetti added Kia outlets, vehicle rental and collision-repair activities, creating an integrated family automotive group. As founder, chairman and dealer principal, he remains directly involved while the next generation joins the business. His career combines a multigenerational automotive apprenticeship with separately acquired and expanded US dealerships.
